## ASCENDANT — The 100th Spire

A self-contained browser RPG. Open `index.html` in a browser (or serve this folder with any static web server) to play. Progress saves automatically in local storage.

Built **ASCENDANT — The 100th Spire**, a complete browser RPG in `index.html`, `style.css`, and `game.js`.

- Fight guardians across **100 floors**, with a boss every tenth floor and a victory sequence at the summit.
- Use strikes, mana-based Arcane Burst, timed evades, and healing potions.
- Earn XP and gold, level up, invest stat points, find stronger weapons, and automatically save progress.
- Play with keyboard or touch-friendly on-screen controls; the layout adapts to mobile.

## Objective
- Complete and validate the 100-floor browser RPG, including combat, services, persistence, the final boss, and responsive controls.
- Add freely assignable stat points, item rarities, and chat-enabled NPCs with stories in safe rooms.

## Requirements
- Keep the existing canvas-rendered arena and vanilla HTML/CSS/JavaScript game.
- Include multi-enemy floors, safe zones, a shop, trading, healing items, ore drops, armor forging, and monster loot.
- Let the player choose which stats receive points.
- Add item rarities and local NPC conversations and stories in safe rooms.

## Decisions
- Floors ending in 5 are safe waystations; floors divisible by 10 are boss floors.
- Stat points are allocated using per-stat `+` buttons.
- NPC conversations and stories work locally without an external chatbot service.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented and browser-validated combat progression, waystation services, multi-enemy combat, boss rewards, defeat recovery, save restoration, and floor-100 victory/reset.
- Fixed the attack animation’s stretching sword arm and corrected the potion hotkey display.
- Verified mobile layout at 390px with no horizontal overflow.
- Added stat allocation controls, rarity-colored relic drops and stat bonuses, rarity labels, inventory display, and three safe-room NPCs with dialogue, stories, and advice.
- Latest `node --check game.js` and `git diff --check` passed.

### Active
- Browser-test stat spending, relic rarity/effects and save restoration, NPC selection/chat/story behavior, safe-room-only access, and responsive layout with the new panels.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Browser-test stat allocation, rarity/persistence, and NPC functionality, including access outside safe rooms.
2. Inspect desktop and 390px mobile layouts; fix any issues found.
3. Rerun syntax and whitespace checks.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: gameplay, persistence, stat allocation, relic drops, NPC dialogue, and rendering.
- `index.html`: stat controls, inventory rarity display, and NPC chat UI.
- `style.css`: stat, rarity, and chat panel styling.
- `README.md`: project documentation.
- `/home/runner/.local/share/omgithub-playwright`: installed Playwright runtime available for browser tests.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted. `README.md` is modified; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `game.js`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, `startup.sh`, and `style.css` are untracked.
- Relic drops have a 36% chance or are guaranteed from bosses; rarities grant +1 to +4 to a random stat.
- Browser tests for the newly added features have not yet been run. Chromium is available at `/usr/bin/chromium`.

## Objective
- Complete and validate the 100-floor browser RPG, including combat, services, persistence, the final boss, and responsive controls.
- Add freely assignable stat points, item rarities, and chat-enabled NPCs with stories in safe rooms.

## Requirements
- Keep the existing canvas-rendered arena and vanilla HTML/CSS/JavaScript game.
- Include multi-enemy floors, safe zones, a shop, trading, healing items, ore drops, armor forging, and monster loot.
- Let the player choose which stats receive points.
- Add item rarities and local NPC conversations and stories in safe rooms.

## Decisions
- Floors ending in 5 are safe waystations; floors divisible by 10 are boss floors.
- Stat points are allocated using per-stat `+` buttons.
- NPC conversations and stories work locally without an external chatbot service.
